ev.q: the six state health departments received 1984 calls about Pp, PLOs, and PEAS ( Table 1 ).
Seventy-eight calls concerned a symptomatic person; 54 (69%) of these persons had possible exposure to estuarine water.
Most (96%) calls involved requests for information about Pp, PLOs, or PEAS.
Most (96%) calls involved requests for information

public_health_question.v: Did passive surveillance in six states during June 1998-December 1999 identify any illnesses meeting PEAS criteria?

ev.q: This report summarizes passive surveillance for PEAS during June 1, 1998--December 31, 1999, which indicated no persons had illnesses that met PEAS criteria.
Surveillance for Possible Estuary-Associated Syndrome --- Six States, 1998--1999
This report summarizes passive surveillance for PEAS
Calls from persons requesting information or reporting symptoms that may be related to Pp or Pfiesteria -like organisms (PLOs) were recorded

notes: Table 1 sets call counts by half-year side by side but the text draws no period comparison; no cases met criteria.
